title: AI companies in regulated markets do not die from lack of technology
subtitle: *They die from lack of governance. Attolloo invests senior executive depth — against equity, not hourly fees.*

sections.body:
Early-stage AI companies in Fintech, Regtech, and ComplianceAutomation face a specific, structural problem in the 12-36 months after firstproduct launch. They have technology that works. What they lack is thegovernance architecture that makes banks, insurers, pension funds, and publicsector organisations willing to buy it, partner with it, and fund it.

The EU AI Act entered full enforcement in August 2026. DORA hasbeen applicable since January 2025. Compliance is no longer a future obligation— it is a present commercial condition. A founder who cannot document AIgovernance to a procurement committee loses the contract. A founder who cannotdemonstrate regulatory readiness to an institutional investor does not closethe round.

This is not a problem a lawyer and a CTO can solvealone. It requires someone who has built governance architecture from theinside — across multiple cycles of regulatory disruption, in the same sectors,with the same institutional stakeholders.
sections.heading: The Governance Gap Is Existential
Capital is Abundant. Executive Governance Depth is Not.
sections.body:
Attolloo Group AS is an asset-light venture studio. I go intoearly-stage AI companies in regulated sectors — not primarily with capital, butwith senior executive depth: CEO governance, CSO risk architecture, and HRDirector leadership — in exchange for equity stakes or performance-basedrevenue shares. 

No hourly fees. No report delivered and forgotten. Skin in thegame from day one.

The engagement is structured around four proprietary frameworks— 6Sense Filter, AI Compass, Polaris Framework, and Kando Framework — developedfrom forty years of operational experience in regulated markets and validatedthrough an MBA and Master of Digital Business at Distinction level.

\> The 6Sense Filter screens every venture beforeengagement begins. If your company does not pass all six dimensions, I say so —early and clearly. The filter exists to protect both parties.

sections.heading: A Proprietary Four-Framework Methodology Stack
sections.body:
Four integrated frameworks govern every Attolloo engagement, from initial qualification to operational execution:

\*\*6Sense Filter\*\*

Six-dimensional qualification gate. Screens for verified market demand, unit economics (CLV:CAC >= 3:1), PMF signals, operational scalability, data quality, and regulatory risk. Every venture passes all six dimensions before engagement begins.

\*\*AI Compass\*\*

1-to-5 star digital and organisational maturity diagnostic. Maps where a company actually is — from manual PDF workflows (1 star) to AI-driven autonomous governance (5 stars). Prescribes a sequenced path forward.

\*\*Polaris Framework\*\*

KPI governance and 90-day execution architecture. Tracks AOV, CLV:CAC, OEE, OTIF, CCC, and CAC Payback Period. Includes Track Synchronisation Protocol for aligning digital sprints with regulatory compliance milestones.

\*\*Kando Framework\*\*

Operational execution and crisis intelligence. Applies Theory of Constraints and Drum-Buffer-Rope logic to executive capacity management. Converts negative events — churn, returns, complaints — into structured strategic intelligence.
